ConnectionStrings.//: Local development default. Points at localhost so `dotnet run` works against a database started by hand or by docker-compose. In containers this is overridden by ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, which points at the `db` service. No credential here is a real one.

Database.//: FR-005: on startup the application waits for storage to accept connections before giving up, so a database that is merely still starting is not mistaken for a fault.
